_meta.kcts_v1_1_alignment: [KCTS v1.1 ALIGNMENT 2026-06] Любые KCTS/AIRE упоминания в этом файле ПОДЧИНЕНЫ и ВЫТЕСНЕНЫ kcts_integration v1.1 (EBM-reframe, решение Mark): оперативная модель — psychosocial burden + chronic-stress physiology + fluid-retention; Hamer/AIRE психоконфликт-каузальность и 'collecting tubule' анатомия ОТВЕРГНУТЫ как механизм (сохранены лишь как раскрытое происхождение); psychosocial-поддержка СОПУТСТВУЮЩАЯ доказательному лечению, никогда вместо/прежде. Legacy 'AIRE-trigger'/'KCTS-active' читать как EBM psychosocial/chronic-stress markers.

kcts_awareness_governance_note._authored_by: METACOD-RF governance layer (not Mark's source text).
kcts_awareness_governance_note.separable_legitimate_evidence: Часть claims этого батча — доказательная и mainstream: medication-assisted treatment (MAT) + психосоциальная поддержка/trauma-informed care/peer support = установленный стандарт лечения зависимостей; фармакотерапия в одиночку даёт худшие исходы. Это валидно НЕЗАВИСИМО от METACOD-рамки.
kcts_awareness_governance_note.unvalidated_framing: Однако формулировки 'AIRE-triggers nearly universal', 'addiction requires AIRE/KCTS resolution', 'pharmacotherapy insufficient без KCTS resolution' в Hamer/AIRE-терминах — это UNVALIDATED research-гипотеза (см. kcts_integration_v1_0.json), а НЕ установленный механизм. 'Психосоциальный компонент важен' ≠ 'Hamer AIRE-конфликт каузально вызывает зависимость'.
kcts_awareness_governance_note.standard_care_primacy: КРИТИЧНО: ничто здесь не откладывает и не заменяет evidence-based addiction care. Naloxone при передозировке — немедленная, жизнеспасающая терапия и НЕ подлежит никакому 'KCTS'-рассуждению. Buprenorphine/methadone/naltrexone — time-sensitive; KCTS-resolution не prerequisite.
kcts_awareness_governance_note.not_operationalized: KCTS-text не инжектируется в движок, не patient-facing.

energy_perspective: Substitution therapy (buprenorphine, methadone, NRT) = controlled replacement reducing harm
Antagonists (naltrexone, naloxone) = blockade preventing reinforcement / reversing overdose
Aversive agents (disulfiram) = negative consequence for drinking
class_warnings: Buprenorphine induction: precipitated withdrawal if full agonist still active — COWS scoring
Naltrexone discontinuation: increased overdose risk if relapse (lost tolerance)
Methadone: QT prolongation, accumulation, narrow margin
Naloxone: short half-life, may need multiple doses (esp. fentanyl)
obs_mark_to_fill: AIRE-trigger pattern в addiction — clinical experience
Integration of pharmacotherapy + psychosocial — practical models

Q for Mark: 'essential' или смягчить к 'highly recommended'? [GOVERNANCE: psychosocial-integration evidence-based; Hamer/AIRE-каузальность — не валидирована.]

logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_3_bupropion_crossref: [RF] Bupropion (smoking, Zyban) — полный профиль в batch 07. Здесь cross-reference. Q: adequate или повторить?
logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_4_public_health: [RF] Naloxone дан с public-health акцентом (harm reduction, take-home). Q: включать policy-level контекст или чисто клинически?

molecular.chemical_class: Partial μ-opioid receptor agonist + κ-receptor antagonist
mechanism_primary: [LBL] Partial μ-agonism — opioid effect с ceiling (safer than full agonist)
[LBL] High receptor affinity — displaces other opioids, blocks subsequent use
mechanism_distinct: [LBL] Ceiling effect на respiratory depression — safer overdose profile

dosing.dose: OUD 8-24 mg/day sublingual; Sublocade 100-300 mg SC monthly; Probuphine implant 6 months
induction: [LBL] Patient должен быть в moderate withdrawal before first dose (precipitated withdrawal risk if full agonist still active)
[LBL] COWS score guidance for induction timing
[LBL] Modern 'micro-induction' protocols — overlap с fentanyl без precipitated withdrawal

constitutional.energy: Controlled Yang restoration в opioid receptor system (partial agonist); translation: partial μ-receptor agonism
constitutional.access_note: Office-based prescribing (vs methadone clinic); X-waiver removed 2023 (MAT Act)

membrane.impact: Chronic stable maintenance; generally safe membrane profile, less catabolic than chronic illicit use; restores hormonal axes disrupted by chronic opioid use (testosterone, cortisol)

phase.match: Acute (induction = Phase 1 withdrawal); chronic maintenance (Phase 5 stabilization); recurrent cycles if relapse → return к Phase 1 stress

serious: [LBL] Respiratory depression (much less than full agonists, but possible)

kcts_awareness_rf._note: [RF] OUD patients often have AIRE-trigger history (childhood trauma, abandonment, isolation), HCV/HIV, single-carrier responsibility, multiple parallel chronic conditions. Source: 'buprenorphine alone often insufficient; KCTS resolution component essential'.
kcts_awareness_rf._governance: [GOVERNANCE] Psychosocial/trauma-informed integration evidence-based; Hamer/AIRE causal framing unvalidated. MAT is time-sensitive — not delayed by KCTS reasoning.

[LBL] NMDA antagonism — useful neuropathic pain context

phase.match: Chronic maintenance / recurrent cycles if relapse

[LBL] Opioid blockade — patient cannot use opioids while на naltrexone effective

approved: [LBL] Alcohol use disorder — maintenance of abstinence

[LBL] Compatible с relapse — reduces craving regardless

[LBL] Causes intensely unpleasant reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting, headache, hypotension)

[LBL] Disulfiram-alcohol reaction can be severe — rarely fatal

critical: [LBL] Major drug interactions — inhibits multiple CYPs

molecular.chemical_class: α4β2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor partial agonist
mechanism_primary: [LBL] Partial agonist — provides some dopamine release (reduces craving)
[LBL] Blocks nicotine binding — reduces reward of smoking if patient lapses

clinical_evidence: [RCT] Most effective single smoking cessation drug — higher abstinence than bupropion or NRT alone
[GL] Combination с NRT может add benefit
[RCT] EAGLES trial: no excess neuropsychiatric harm vs bupropion vs placebo (changed earlier FDA black box)

dosing.dose: 0.5-1 mg titration over 1 week, then 1 mg BID × 12 weeks
administration: [LBL] Pre-quit start 7-14 days before quit date
[LBL] Flexible approach: can start while still smoking

constitutional.energy: Nicotinic receptor modulation reducing dependence; translation: partial agonism at nicotinic receptor

membrane.impact: 12-week course; smoking cessation = significant membrane benefit long-term (reduced oxidative stress, M-D drift)

[LBL] Cardiovascular events — slight signal in some studies, controversial

categories: Long-acting (background): patches 21/14/7 mg — taper over weeks
Short-acting (PRN cravings): gum 2/4 mg, lozenges 2/4 mg, inhaler, nasal spray (strongest, fastest)

drugs.combination_approach: Best practice: patch (background) + PRN short-acting (cravings) = combination NRT — significantly better than monotherapy.

[LBL] Withdrawal symptoms в dependent patients (expected, not dangerous)
